title: Apply for access to Dealer Online
summary: The Dealer Online (DOL) system allows motor vehicle dealers to complete registration transactions online without visiting a Service NSW Centre.
intro:
The Dealer Online (DOL) system allows motor vehicle dealers to complete registration transactions online, without having to visit a Service NSW Centre.

With DOL you can:

DOL is available to all dealers who have a Dealer Vehicle Registration Scheme (DVRS) agreement with Transport for NSW (except dealers whose agreements are under review). To have an agreement, you need to meet the eligibility criteria and make an application through a service centre.
who_can_apply: Motor vehicle dealers with a Dealer Vehicle Registration Scheme (DVRS) agreement with Transport for NSW (except dealers whose agreements are under review).
what_you_need: Evidence that you are a member of the DVRS.

faqs.q: Who can use the Dealer Online (DOL) system?
faqs.a: DOL is available to all dealers who have a Dealer Vehicle Registration Scheme (DVRS) agreement with Transport for NSW, provided their agreements are not under review.

faqs.q: How do I apply for DOL access?
faqs.a: To gain access, you must meet the eligibility criteria and submit an application through a service centre.

faqs.q: What is required to use DOL?
faqs.a: You need to have a DVRS agreement and submit an application at a service centre.
